items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: He left that to the Latin fellow to say if the number was good or not good.

ctx.x: I see. Okay, I get you now. All right. Tunes like 'Tanga-Si'....... (End of cassette 2, side 1)
He never was involved with a Latin thing. He left that to the Latin fellow to say if the number was good or not good.
